sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT KIND OF PETS THE OTHER CALLER HAS.
turns: So, do you have any pets?
Yes, I do have a pet! I have a dog named Max. How about you? Do you have any pets?
That's so great that you have a dog! I used to have a dog too, but he passed away a few years ago. It was really tough, but I still miss him a lot. How old is your dog Max?
Max is 5 years old. He's a golden retriever and he's such a sweet dog. I love taking him for walks and playing fetch with him. What kind of pet did you used to have?
I used to have a cat named Whiskers. She was a beautiful calico cat and had the sweetest personality. I loved her so much and still think about her often. Do you have any other pets besides Max?
No, just Max. I always thought about getting another pet, but I travel a lot for work and I don't want to leave him alone for too long. How long did you have Whiskers?
I had Whiskers for about 10 years. She was with me through a lot of life changes and was always there for me. It's hard to lose a pet, but I'm glad I had the opportunity to love and care for her.
I'm sorry for your loss, it's never easy saying goodbye to a beloved pet. I can imagine how difficult it must have been for you. What did you do to cope with the loss of Whiskers?

Thank you, it was definitely a tough experience. I found comfort in talking to other pet owners who had gone through similar situations and also by volunteering at a local animal shelter. It helped me feel like I was making a difference in the lives of other animals and also gave me a sense of purpose.
